title: Representative normalization for tensor-Hom descent
statement: For a scheme X with chosen derived category, there exists a family t of functions Hom(K,RHom(L,M)) to Hom(K tensor^L L,M) whose value on every K-flat complex P, arbitrary complexes L,M, and chain map phi:P to Hom(L,I(M)) obeys exactly the localization equation of lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-descent. No compatibility on objects outside these normalized inputs is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08DJ; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A90, 0A96; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DJ, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A90, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A96

proof.text: For fixed derived objects K,L,M and an input f, define a relation R(f,g) saying that a K-flat chain presentation of f has localized uncurried output g, using heterogeneous equality to transport along literal object equalities. Given two witnesses, compose their object equalities and input HEq proofs, apply representative coherence, and compose with the output HEq proofs. This proves uniqueness of g. Define t(f) to be the unique output if there exists one, and zero otherwise. For each displayed chain input, its own P,L,M,phi give a witness, and uniqueness supplies an ExistsUnique proof. Unfold the dependent if and apply uniqueness to the chosen output and the given output to prove the required normalization equation. The choice is from a uniquely determined object, not from arbitrary mere existence.

theorem exists_tensorHomUncurry_descent_representative (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    ∃ t : ∀ K L M : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (K ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
        X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op L, M)) → (K ⊗ L ⟶ M),
      ∀ (P L M : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        P.IsKFlat →
        ∀ φ : P ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L
            ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M),
          t (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫
                (schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).inv) =
            pullbackTensorModelMap X P L ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X P L M φ) ≫
                schemeHomResolutionInverse X M
